# STAR8S

> > STAR8S offers authentic Hetian jade jewelry and Chinese zodiac accessories, featuring handcrafted bracelets, necklaces, and spiritual amulets with traditional symbolism.

STAR8S specializes in premium Hetian jade jewelry from Qinghai and Xinjiang regions, combining traditional Chinese craftsmanship with modern minimalist design. The collection includes Feng Shui wealth talismans, zodiac-themed pieces, and culturally significant accessories crafted with 925 silver and 14K gold-plated accents.
